pages.title: Salves
pages.text: Salves are quick-use consumables crafted with the $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/mortar_and_pestle)Mortar and Pestle$(/l). They provide immediate effects, making them ideal for reactive use in combat or survival situations.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Unlike brews, salves act instantly and last for a short duration. They are simple to prepare and are best used when immediate response is needed.

pages.title: Brambleguard Salve
pages.text: Grants Brambleguard, increasing armor and providing immunity to Bleeding effects.

pages.title: Mender's Salve
pages.text: Applies Regeneration for a short duration, restoring health over time.

pages.title: On Preparation
pages.text: Salves are faster to prepare than more complex mixtures, making them a reliable option when time and resources are limited.
